# isral Duke

> Design Manager who can code, leading a team creating accessible and easy to use products.

Fifteen years designing and coding standards-compliant products, a state design system, a digital drivers license, and telemedicine tooling. I make things everyone can use.

## Skills

### Accessibility

- Accessible Markup
- Proper ARIA
- WCAG 2.2
- Screen Readers

### Design

- Inclusive Design
- Design Systems
- Product Design
- Visual Design

### Technical

- Accessible Markup
- Frontend
- HTML, SCSS, CSS
- Working within technical constraints

### User Experience

- User Research
- Information Architecture
- Accessible Content
- Public Speaking

## Product Design Projects

- [Art Gallery App](https://isralduke.com/product-design/art-gallery-app/): Art gallery app helps visitors plan trips, see current artwork collections, and buy tickets for themselves and loved ones.
- [Budget App](https://isralduke.com/product-design/budget-app/): Budgeting app helps people who are new to budgeting create a budget and think along with their budget as they spend.
- [Design System](https://isralduke.com/product-design/design-system/): Design System allows team members to access a single source of truth and quickly produce value.
- [Event Guide App](https://isralduke.com/product-design/event-guide-app/): Mobile app provides conference attendees quick access to relevant presentation details and schedule information.
- [Food Truck Site](https://isralduke.com/product-design/food-truck-site/): A responsive website for a food truck allows visitors to find its daily location and pay ahead.
- [Karaoke App](https://isralduke.com/product-design/karaoke-app/): iOS application allows patrons to create and participate in ad hoc karaoke competitions.
- [Medical Diagnosis App](https://isralduke.com/product-design/medical-diagnosis-app/): Web application allows licensed medical personnel to remotely diagnose patients.
- [Sketch Note App](https://isralduke.com/product-design/sketch-note-app/): Sketch note app allows users to create quick sticky notes on their phones.
- [Step Counter App](https://isralduke.com/product-design/step-counter-app/): A watchOS and iOS step counter app which gives users a glanceable view of their steps as a watch face complication with an accompanying iOS app.

## Talks

- [Just in Time Usability](https://youtu.be/UNe7NsCdfUE): Isral Duke presents why accessibility is important for business. He also presents 10 things that site owners can do to quick check their site&#39;s accessibility and usability. Presented at a local ecommerce group lunch.
- [Accessible, Friendly Content](https://youtu.be/zyohrLEZfys): Isral Duke demonstrates how iOS and MacOS VoiceOver presents a simple web page. This talk promotes the use of semantic, meaningful markup to make a better user experience. Presented at Google Developer Groups.
- [Building Pelican Design System](https://youtu.be/ZKYufkpBG6Q): Isral Duke presents version one of Pelican Design System. He talks about how it was created, and what&#39;s coming next in version two. Presented at SQL Saturday.
